info.title: rs-admin API
info.description: API for the rs-admin login and permission system. Health probes are served at the root; business endpoints are served under `/api/v1`.

ChangePasswordResponse.description:
`POST /auth/change-password` success body; the rotated refresh token is
only in the `Set-Cookie` header.

ErrorCode.description: Stable, closed catalog of API error codes. Clients must map unknown future codes to a generic fallback.

HealthState.description: Probe state returned by the health endpoints.

HealthStatus.description: Body returned by the health probes.

LogoutRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /auth/logout` and `POST /auth/logout-all`. Both
identify the caller by cookie or Bearer token, so the body is an empty JSON
object.

PermissionGroup.description: A permission group in catalog order.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every API error.

code.description: Stable error code from the closed catalog.

details.description:
Optional structured context for machine handling. Reauthentication refusals add
`{"max_age": <seconds>}` (spec §5.8); other errors usually omit it.

RefreshRequest.description:
`POST /auth/refresh` request body. The refresh token travels only in the
`__Host-refresh` cookie, so the body is an empty JSON object.

RefreshResponse.description:
`POST /auth/refresh` success body; the rotated refresh token is only in the
`Set-Cookie` header.

RoleRefResponse.description: A role as exposed by `/auth/me` and the login response.

RoleSummary.description: A role as returned by the list endpoint.

UpdateRoleRequest.description:
`PATCH /roles/{id}` request body. Omitted fields are unchanged; an explicit
`null` description clears it.

name.description:
Omitted means unchanged; `null` is rejected because names are not
nullable.

UserSelfResponse.description: The current user's profile, roles and effective permissions.
